title: Pricing Strategy Overhaul
description: Your freemium conversion rate is 2%. Should you kill free, add usage-based pricing, or raise prices across the board?

options.label: Kill freemium
options.description: Remove the free tier entirely. Forces conversion but risks losing top-of-funnel volume and word-of-mouth.

options.label: Add usage-based tier
options.description: Layer in a pay-as-you-go option alongside flat plans. Lowers friction for high-usage power users.

options.label: Raise prices 30%
options.description: Increase paid plan prices by 30%. Tests price elasticity and improves unit economics if churn stays flat.

free_users.label: Free Users
free_users.description: Number of active users on the free tier.

paid_users.label: Paid Users
paid_users.description: Number of users on a paid plan.

mrr.label: Current MRR ($)
mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue from paid subscribers.

arpu.label: Average Revenue per User ($)
arpu.description: Average monthly revenue per paid user.

churn_rate.label: Monthly Churn Rate
churn_rate.description: Monthly paid user churn rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.05 = 5%).
